subject: Annual commitment funding gating and collector runway — VAT mapping for EU entities
messages:
From: Anna Lambert <anna.lambert@aegiscloud.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@aegiscloud.com; cfo@aegiscloud.com
Date: 2028-05-31T09:12:00+01:00
Subject: Redwood annual commitment — request to confirm funding gates and VAT flow

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the demo last week — Aegis is keen to move forward with a 12-month committed spend. Before legal and treasury sign off, procurement needs clarity on the invoicing cadence and two items that are gating our internal approval: 

1) Collector runway: we need a clear monthly drawdown plan and a single point of contact for collections if invoices are delayed.
2) EU VAT mapping: we have entities in DE and FR — we need to confirm which entity receives the invoice and whether VAT will be reverse-charged or charged by Redwood.

Can you share a proposed MAP (mutual action plan) that ties invoicing milestones to funding tranche releases? Also please include a sample invoice PDF for our treasury to validate bank details and remittance fields.

Best,
Anna Lambert
Head of Procurement | Aegis Cloud
anna.lambert@aegiscloud.com
+44 20 7946 0123

Attachment: None

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Anna Lambert <anna.lambert@aegiscloud.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai; markus_klein@redwood.ai; naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-05-31T10:40:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Redwood annual commitment — request to confirm funding gates and VAT flow

Anna — thanks for the clear ask. We've drafted a MAP and VAT mapping for DE/FR that should address treasury's gating checklist. High-level summary below and attached: AEG-MAP-v3.xlsx and VAT-mapping-EU.pdf.

- Collector runway: proposed monthly drawdowns on the 1st of each month. Initial upfront invoice (month 0) for 30% to activate dedicated capacity, followed by 9 equal monthly instalments for the remaining committed spend.
- Late-payment handling: 5 business day grace; collections escalation to our finance lead (Markus Klein) at day 7, followed by a payment hold on burst capacity at day 14.
- VAT flow: for DE entity we recommend invoicing Redwood -> Aegis DE with reverse-charge if you provide VAT registration to us; for FR entity we'll issue a standard VAT invoice unless you confirm reverse-charge eligibility. See attached VAT-mapping-EU.pdf.
- Samples: Invoice-Template-Q2.pdf demonstrates required fields + remittance instructions; DocuSign envelope will be used for signature when both sides agree.

Action items (proposed):
1) Procurement to confirm billing entity for DE and FR by EOD Jun 2.
2) Aegis treasury to confirm whether reverse charge applies for DE entity (send VAT registration).
3) Redwood to issue final MAP and DocuSign envelope after confirmation (target Jun 4).

I'm looping Markus (finance) for collection SLAs and Naomi for VAT evidence collection.

Thanks — Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Attachments: AEG-MAP-v3.xlsx (spreadsheet), VAT-mapping-EU.pdf (pdf), Invoice-Template-Q2.pdf (pdf)

From: procurement@aegiscloud.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai; lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: cfo@aegiscloud.com; anna.lambert@aegiscloud.com
Date: 2028-06-01T08:05:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Redwood annual commitment — request to confirm funding gates and VAT flow

Karthik / Lauren — thanks for the prompt response. A couple of clarifications from treasury: 

- We prefer the drawdown dates to align with our payroll window; can we move monthly billing to the 5th of each month instead of the 1st?
- For DE: confirmed — Aegis DE will provide VAT registration (attached) and prefers reverse-charge.
- For FR: please issue standard VAT invoices to Aegis FR.

Procurement will return a redline to the MAP with those date changes by close of day June 2. Please confirm Markus will be the escalation point for collections and the account team will temporarily keep burst capacity enabled during the 7-day grace.

Regards,
Procurement Team | Aegis Cloud
procurement@aegiscloud.com

Attachment: Aegis-DE-VAT-reg.pdf

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: Anna Lambert <anna.lambert@aegiscloud.com>; procurement@aegiscloud.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai; lauren_bishop@redwood.ai; naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-06-01T11:20:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Redwood annual commitment — request to confirm funding gates and VAT flow

Anna / Procurement — Markus here (Finance). Confirming: we can shift the monthly invoice date to the 5th (aligned with your payroll). Our escalation policy: day 7 finance alert to me; day 14 temporary hold on burst capacity and 10% holdback on next invoice until remittance is received unless a signed payment plan exists.

On VAT: thanks for the DE VAT reg — Naomi, please capture that in the VAT evidence folder and route to our tax advisor for reverse-charge documentation. Naomi will confirm once done.

I will prepare a short collections playbook and add it to the MAP before we finalize.

Cheers,
Markus Klein
Head of Finance | Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai

Attachment: Collections-Playbook-Short.pdf

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Anna Lambert <anna.lambert@aegiscloud.com>; procurement@aegiscloud.com
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.ai; lauren_bishop@redwood.ai; naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-06-01T16:05:00+01:00
Subject: Final MAP & next steps (DocuSign ready)

Anna / Team — appreciate the quick turnaround. Updated MAP attached (AEG-MAP-v3.xlsx) with:
- Monthly invoice moved to the 5th, first upfront activation invoice = 30% on signature, then 9 monthly instalments on the 5th.
- Collections playbook embedded (see Collections-Playbook-Short.pdf).
- VAT flow captured: DE = reverse-charge (Aegis DE VAT reg received); FR = standard VAT invoicing.

Next steps: 
1) Procurement to review the redline in the MAP and confirm by Jun 4.
2) Once confirmed, we'll send the DocuSign envelope for signature (Invoice + SOW + MAP).
3) Finance will send the first invoice immediately after signature and confirm bank remittance details.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/envelope/0a1b2c
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/record/AEG-2028-07

If that all looks good, I'll queue the envelope this evening so treasury has a single package for approval.

Thanks — Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Attachments: AEG-MAP-v3.xlsx, VAT-mapping-EU.pdf, Invoice-Template-Q2.pdf
